name: Hitoyomishi
source:
Among the fortune-tellers there are people who specialize into "reading people". With the decline of magic these people become appreciated as advisers. Main character is one of such readers who is kept at the border of the state to help officials and bring up disciples. This is a small story about an incident with hearing voice of a girl disappeared half a year ago.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-april-2006-tenshitsuki-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
